title: Fix a port configuration
description: The API is running, yet its health endpoint is unreachable on the expected port. Find the mismatch and apply an approved configuration.

objectives.label: Find the listening port in the logs or inspect output
Run the API on the expected probe port 3000
Verify a successful health response on port 3000

hints: Inspect the api container or read its logs: which port does the process listen on?
Probes and the image healthcheck target port 3000, the expected port of this lab. The probe target cannot be changed.
Set appPort to 3000 in the container configuration and apply it; the workload is replaced with the new setting.
solution: Docker panel: set appPort to 3000 and apply the configuration
